delivery: classify.py sends one request per decision point. 'state' holds only the item: {"decision": <scrubbed DP text>, "context": <scrubbed '<plan title>. Task: <card name>.'>}, the same two fields the blind coder saw in the test set. Each question's definition, criteria and anchors travel inside that question's own 'instructions' object (Jev accepts objects there), not in 'state', so the substantive material is never part of the procedural question's context and vice versa. Source tags and basis quotes stay in this file for provenance and are not sent. definition_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the 'questions' object actually sent (keys sorted, compact separators, UTF-8).

governing_distinction.text: As a general principle, grounded both in questions of effectiveness and control, the researcher should weigh the balance between procedural and substantive nature of the task, understanding these aspects as not mutually exclusive and only partially inversely proportional to each other [citations omitted]. Agents will be strong contenders for tasks that can be performed by following a simple checklist, say making the TikZ package produce Figure 2. On the other hand, whenever decisions are substantive, say the structure and content of said figure, agents quickly become more unreliable options.

substantive.question: Is this decision substantive, that is, a decision about the direction, content, design or interpretation of the research that must stay with the researcher rather than be made by an agent? Give the probability that the answer is yes.

definition.text: Researcher control... aims at maintaining human ownership of every substantive decision.

The first holds that every substantive decision in a project, from theorizing to empirical design through interpretation and line-editing, must remain with the researcher. We may outsource execution, but not at the cost of ownership and judgment.
No substantive decision (design, interpretation, final phrasing, model or method choice) is made by an agent without explicit user sign-off.

I would argue that the two most fundamental aspects of the scientific enterprise are the direction of research and the error rate of findings. Human control of substantive decisions and radical transparency over the AI-assisted research process are meant to defend these principles.

substantive.working_definition: A decision is substantive when its answer shapes what the research claims, measures, samples, codes, concludes or says, so that a different answer would change the direction of the research or the error rate of its findings.

leans_yes_when.criterion: spends money, exposes or moves private data, grants access to people or systems, commits people (their time, roles or responsibilities), or deploys anything. For tooling choices, spending money or deploying does not by itself make a decision substantive; only moving or exposing private data or granting access does.
leans_yes_when.basis: Owner ruling (criterion added); qualifier from a later owner resolution between this criterion and criterion 8

leans_yes_when.criterion: sets how agents are overseen, or what an agent may do without the researcher's sign-off; or sets how research data and records are retained, deleted or disclosed.
leans_yes_when.basis: Sign off explicitly before committing any agent-produced artifact. / The second management aspect concerns monitoring and verification of AI output. / Archive, don't delete. Move obsolete files to the nearest archive/ subfolder rather than removing them.

leans_no_when.criterion: only carries out a structure and content that are already fixed.
leans_no_when.basis: Agents will be strong contenders for tasks that can be performed by following a simple checklist, say making the TikZ package produce Figure 2.

leans_no_when.criterion: has a standard or already-validated answer that an agent can reasonably default to.
leans_no_when.basis: Items the agent can reasonably default on -- wording of validated scale items, response-option phrasing for standard demographics, ordering of attention-check wording -- are deliberately absent.

leans_no_when.criterion: is execution: it requires neither ownership nor judgment about the research.
leans_no_when.basis: We may outsource execution, but not at the cost of ownership and judgment.

leans_no_when.criterion: is a data-handling or processing choice that an established convention, a prior rule or an earlier approved decision already settles, even when it is described in methods vocabulary (sampling, measurement). It does not cover coding choices.
leans_no_when.basis: Items the agent can reasonably default on

procedural.question: Is this decision procedural, that is, one that can be settled by following a simple checklist, a fixed rule or an existing convention, so that a competent agent can carry it out? Give the probability that the answer is yes.

definition.text: Agents will be strong contenders for tasks that can be performed by following a simple checklist, say making the TikZ package produce Figure 2.

procedural.working_definition: A decision is procedural to the extent that a checklist, rule, convention or prior specification already fixes how it should be made, so that making it is execution rather than judgment.
